data.name: Spending Fabula Points
table: Spend 1 FP after performing a Check to invoke a trait to reroll one or both dice.
Spend 1 FP after performing a Check to invoke a bond and add its strength to the result.
Spend 1 FP to alter the story. If you are altering an existing element, you need permission from whoever introduced it.

data.name: Optional: Experience from Fabula Points
data.description: At the end of a session, each character gains XP equal to the amount of Fabula Points spent by the group during the session, divided by the number of Player Characters that took part. Record the remainder and add it to the Fabula Points spent during the next session so no FP goes wasted.

data.name: Optional: Applause Points
data.description:
Each Player begins the session with 1 Applause Point (represented by distinct physical tokens).

When someone feels that another Player's actions, decisions, ideas, or descriptions led to an especially memorable, epic, or heartwarming moment, they can give that Player their starting Applause Point as a sign of appreciation. The Game Master cannot give nor receive Applause Points.

When a Player spends one or more Fabula Points, they may instead spend one Applause Point from those they have received (they cannot spend the point they started the session with). Doing so does not count as spending a Fabula Point, and spent Applause Points do not generate XP at the end of a session. All remaining Applause Points are discarded at the end of each session.
